description: This is a source code file for a Razor Pages model handling user logout functionality within an ASP.NET Core application, specifically in the Identity area of the Web project. It manages user sign-out, cache updates, and redirect behavior after logout.

classes.name: LogoutModel
classes.description: A Razor Pages PageModel class responsible for handling user logout operations, including sign-out, cache management, and redirection.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests; currently does nothing.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to log out the user, sign out of authentication schemes, update cache, log the event, and redirect accordingly.
